name: library-usage-benchmark-2026
description: A 2026 Hugging Face benchmark that measures models' ability to use programming libraries/APIs correctly by generating or invoking library code and producing functionally correct usage. reputation: An emerging dataset hosted on Hugging Face (2026) for library/API usage evaluation; early adoption in code-model research but not yet broadly established.
